values.Description:
Annaprasan Decoration Kit (54 Pieces) - First Rice Ceremony Set

Create a colourful decoration for an Annaprasan or first rice ceremony using red colour metallic balloons, gold colour metallic balloons, a printed Annaprasan banner, heart foil balloons and themed props. Suitable for home celebrations and photo backdrops.

The included pump, arch tape and glue dot stripe help assemble the balloon display. LED light adds decoration to the backdrop.

 What You Get (54 Pieces)
1 Annaprasan Banner
20 Red Metallic Balloons
20 Gold Metallic Balloons
8 Heart Foil Balloons
1 Pump
1 LED Light 10 Mtr
1 Arch Tape
1 Glue Dote Stripe
1 Annaprasan With Props Kit

 Key Features
 54 Pieces - Complete decoration set
 Banner - Annaprasan printed design
 Balloons - Red and gold colours
 Setup - Pump and tapes included
 Props - 16 piece themed kit

 Perfect For
Annaprasan Ceremony
First Rice Ceremony
Baby Celebration
Home Decoration
Photo Backdrop

 Why Choose This Kit?

Everything needed for the displayed decoration is packed together for easy setup.

 Arrange the balloons banner props and LED light to create a festive backdrop.
